messages:
sara-cs: FYI — customer reports promo code REDWOOD50 accepted at signup but no credits applied to balance. Account acct_9f3b, email user@example.com. UI shows 'Promo applied' banner but ledger shows no credit txn. Anyone seen this?

jason-accounts: Can you paste the code and account id so I can look up ledger entries? Also did they have any prior promo?

sara-cs: Code=REDWOOD50, acct_9f3b. New signup today, says they expected promo + free trial credits to stack. Screenshot attached showing banner. No txn in the payments_ledger.

billing-bot: Redemption event recorded: redemption_id=r_84fe, account=acct_9f3b, code=REDWOOD50, amount_cents=0, status=success, note=plan_mismatch

liz-ops: amount_cents=0 usually means promo rules evaluated to zero (e.g., promo restricted to paid plans). @jason-accounts can you check the promo config and rule set?

jason-accounts: Looking... REDWOOD50 config -> amount_cents=5000, allowed_plans=[paid_monthly], stack_with_trial=false, one_time=true. So it intentionally excludes free_trial. That explains the zero result even though UI accepted the code.

sara-cs: Customer assumed promo would apply during free trial. They entered code at signup. They want the $50 credit; can we grant manually and send apologetic note?

ashley-eng: We can issue a manual credit. SQL to apply (ops-run):

  INSERT INTO credits (account_id, amount_cents, reason, source, created_at) VALUES ('acct_9f3b', 5000, 'manual promo grant REDWOOD50', 'support_manual', now());

Then refresh billing cache: POST /internal/billing/refresh?account=acct_9f3b

I can run with ops approval.

liz-ops: Approve manual grant. Also please open a follow-up to update promo UI to show incompatibility with free trial.

ashley-eng: Applied manual credit. redemption_override_id=ro_2024_559, ledger_txn=txn_77321. Triggered billing cache refresh. Customer balance now +$50.

sara-cs: Customer confirmed they see the $50 credit. Sent apology and note. They requested an update when this is fixed upstream.

jason-accounts: I'll file change request to either allow stacking for REDWOOD50 or update promo text. Creating ticket #1029. Also logging audit: link redemption r_84fe -> manual override ro_2024_559, note appended.

sara-cs: :thumbsup: closing on our side once ticket created. Can we add an automated monitor so accepted redemptions with amount_cents==0 alert support?

liz-ops: Good idea. I'll add an alert: if redemption.status==accepted && amount_cents==0 -> create incident in Sentry and page oncall. Also add a runbook entry for manual grants and proper messaging.

sara-cs: Thanks all — resolved from support POV.
